body.name: positive-definite fixed-interior witness
body.construction: Specialize to \(d=2\), \(\tau=1\), and \(K=[-2,2]\). Fix \(a_{\mathrm{int}}\in(0,1)\) with \(1-a_{\mathrm{int}}^2>\delta_0\), and use \(P_{n,t}^{\mathrm{int}}\) for \(t\in[-\bar T,\bar T]\). The compatibility regime is \(c_{\beta}\leq1\), \(m_{\Sigma}\leq(3-\sqrt5)/2\), \(M_{\Sigma}\geq(3+\sqrt5)/2\), \(M_8\geq1920\{(3+\sqrt5)/2\}^4\), \(c_{\sigma}\leq a_{\mathrm{int}}\), \(C_{\sigma}\geq10\), and \(m_K\leq1\).
